docs.summary: The GLSL preprocessor. Runs before the parser: it handles `#define` (object and function-like macros), `#undef`, the conditional family (`#if/#ifdef/#ifndef/#elif/#else/#endif`) with `#if` constant-expression evaluation and the `defined` operator, `##` token pasting, the predefined macros `__LINE__ / __FILE__ / __VERSION__` and glslang's preamble (`VULKAN`, `GL_ES`, the supported-extension macros, ...), records `#version`, and resolves `#include` through an [`IncludeCallback`](#api~Prowl.Prism.Glsl.IncludeCallback). Callers may inject macros up front (this is how shader variants are compiled). It consumes the raw token stream (including [`Hash`](#api~Prowl.Prism.Glsl.TokenKind~Hash)) and produces a clean token stream for the [`Parser`](#api~Prowl.Prism.Glsl.Parser).

docs.summary: Preprocesses a shader source and returns the result as GLSL text, along with the state the preprocessor found. Unlike [`Process`](#api~Prowl.Prism.Glsl.Preprocessor~Process), this does not run the version, reserved-word, or ES checks, so it can return text for source that the compiler would reject.
